(i) When \(f(x)=1\), \(g(x)=e^x\), \(a=0\), \(b=t\):

\[ \left( \int_0^t e^x\,dx \right)^2 \le \left( \int_0^t 1\,dx \right)\left( \int_0^t e^{2x}\,dx \right). \]
\[ (e^t-1)^2 \le t\cdot \frac{e^{2t}-1}{2} \]
\[ (e^t-1)^2 \le \frac{t}{2}(e^t-1)(e^t+1). \]
\[ \because t>0 \quad \therefore e^t-1>0 \]
\[ \frac{e^t-1}{e^t+1} \le \frac{t}{2}. \]

(ii) When \(f(x)=x\), \(g(x)=e^{-x^2/4}\), \(a=0\), \(b=1\):

\[ \left( \int_0^1 xe^{-x^2/4}\,dx \right)^2 \le \left( \int_0^1 x^2\,dx \right)\left( \int_0^1 e^{-x^2/2}\,dx \right). \]
\[ \because \int_0^1 x^2\,dx=\frac13 \quad \&\& \quad \int_0^1 xe^{-x^2/4}\,dx=\left[-2e^{-x^2/4}\right]_0^1=2(1-e^{-1/4}) \]
\[ 4(1-e^{-1/4})^2 \le \frac13\int_0^1 e^{-x^2/2}\,dx, \]
\[ \int_0^1 e^{-x^2/2}\,dx \ge 12(1-e^{-1/4})^2. \]

(iii) When \(f(x)=1\), \(g(x)=\sqrt{\sin x}\), \(a=0\), \(b=\frac{\pi}{2}\):

\[ \left( \int_0^{\pi/2} \sqrt{\sin x}\,dx \right)^2 \le \left( \int_0^{\pi/2} 1\,dx \right)\left( \int_0^{\pi/2} \sin x\,dx \right). \]
\[ \left( \int_0^{\pi/2} \sqrt{\sin x}\,dx \right)^2 \le \frac{\pi}{2}. \]
\[ \because \sin x>0,\quad x\in\left[0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right] \]
\[ \int_0^{\pi/2} \sqrt{\sin x}\,dx \le \sqrt{\frac{\pi}{2}}. \]

When \(f(x)=\cos x\), \(g(x)=(\sin x)^{1/4}\), \(a=0\), \(b=\frac{\pi}{2}\):

\[ \left( \int_0^{\pi/2} (\sin x)^{1/4}\cos x\,dx \right)^2 \le \left( \int_0^{\pi/2} \cos^2 x\,dx \right)\left( \int_0^{\pi/2} \sqrt{\sin x}\,dx \right). \]
\[ \because \int_0^{\pi/2} (\sin x)^{1/4} \cos x\,dx = \left[ \frac{4}{5}(\sin x)^{5/4} \right]_0^{\pi/2} = \frac{4}{5} \]
\[ \because \int_0^{\pi/2} \cos^2 x\,dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{1+\cos(2x)}{2}\,dx = \left[ \frac{x}{2} + \frac{\sin(2x)}{4} \right]_0^{\pi/2} = \frac{\pi}{4} \]
\[ \therefore \left( \frac{4}{5} \right)^2 \le \frac{\pi}{4} \cdot \int_0^{\pi/2} \sqrt{\sin x}\,dx \]
\[ \implies \frac{16}{25} \le \frac{\pi}{4} \cdot \int_0^{\pi/2} \sqrt{\sin x}\,dx \]
\[ \implies \frac{64}{25\pi} \le \int_0^{\pi/2} \sqrt{\sin x}\,dx \]
\[ \implies \frac{64}{25\pi} \le \int_0^{\pi/2} \sqrt{\sin x}\,dx \le \sqrt{\frac{\pi}{2}} \]
